description: Phase 6T corpus: natural-language engineering questions executed through the autonomous orchestrator. Structural expectations only (statuses, stage coverage, evidence presence, deterministic identities) - never invented numeric answers. Limitation cases assert honest failure states.

conventions.expect.status: allowed terminal statuses for the run
conventions.expect.question_type: intake classification that must be produced (when PARSED-class statuses are expected)
conventions.expect.requires_stage: lifecycle stages that must appear COMPLETED
conventions.expect.limitation_reason_contains: substring the honest failure reason must carry
conventions.expect.deterministic: run twice; run_id and decision trace must be identical
